name: dev.agentcaliper/registry-evidence
title: AgentCaliper Registry Evidence
description: Read signed MCP Registry observations, recent version changes, and AgentCaliper API discovery.

tools.name: check_dependency_changes
tools.description: Compare observed MCP Registry publication changes, declared runtime contract metadata, and opt-in publisher-signed baselines for one exact MCP Registry dependency since a baseline version or timestamp.

name.description: Exact qualified official MCP Registry name.

sinceVersion.description: Optional last known-good version to diff from.

sinceObservedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp from a prior check.

tools.name: get_registry_listing_history
tools.description: Look up up to 24 observed versions, lifecycle statuses, declared transports, and contract metadata for one exact MCP Registry name. Use the official registry to confirm the current listing.

tools.name: get_registry_brief_preview
tools.description: Return the dated sample and coverage of the MCP Registry brief.

tools.name: get_registry_observation_receipt
tools.description: Return a signed receipt covering official MCP registry publication observations.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Return free resources, product prices, and enabled payment modes.
